description: Übergeordnetes Strassennetz des Kantons Bern is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Amt für Geoinformation des Kantons Bern. Das übergeordnete Strassennetz des Kantons Bern (UESN) beinhaltet die Achsen der Kantonsstrassen, der im Kanton Bern liegenden Nationalstrassen, sowie der wichtigen Gemeindestrassen. Die Kantonsstrassenabschnitte sind gemäss den Kategorien des Strassennetzplans (SG, Art. 25) unterteilt. Coverage: Amt für Geoinformation des Kantons Bern. The portal files it under the publisher Amt für Geoinformation des Kantons Bern. It offers 6 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML, OCTET, PARQUET. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
